messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager: high-rate 401/403s observed from inference-ws in us-west-2 (alert id: pb-9844). Suspect: recent logging forwarder change.

Sasha: seeing same -- spikes from service 'inference-ws-prod' starting 2026-03-19T22:34Z. quick grep shows header fragment in logs: 
```
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci...
```

Omar: wow that's a token snippet. Is this staging -> prod log-forwarder mis-route? I rolled out the logging change yesterday.

Lena: confirmed config change: fluent-forwarder v2 to external-obs endpoint. There was an exclude-filter intended for dev logs, but regex did not match websocket headers.

Marta: triage priority: rotate any exposed keys, stop forwarder, and assess customer impact. I'll take rotations. Omar, can you rollback / mute forwarder?

Omar: on it. `kubectl -n infra set env ds/fluent-forwarder FORWARDING_ENABLED=false` -> applied. stopping now.

Sasha: stopping reduced new occurrences, but past forwarded objects exist in external bucket `ext-logs-prod-2026-03-19`. I've pulled a sample and it includes ~40 unique auth header fragments.

security-bot: LINK: https://internal.sec/redacted/incident/pb-9844 - preliminary risk: medium (possible token exposure to 3rd-party logging).

Marta: starting KMS rotation for the service tokens that could be present. I will target service principal: svc-inference-ws. ETA 12 minutes.

oncall-eng: heads-up to SRE: enable short-term denylist for tokens minted in last 48h from svc-inference-ws until rotation finishes. Run `authctl revoke --scope svc-inference-ws --issued-after 2026-03-18T00:00Z`.

Lena: executing denylist command now, dry-run looks ok; executing revoke.

Sasha: also kicking off a quick search across external bucket for full `Authorization:` prefix to enumerate potential customer tokens. Sharing findings to sec channel.

cust-success: tagging this for potential customer comms. Any evidence of customer PII or request bodies being forwarded?

Sasha: sample shows only header snippets and some small debug payloads (no user messages). No large request bodies seen in sample. Will continue scan.

Marta: rotations completed for svc-inference-ws, new keys should be effective. Verifying token issuance logs for failures.

security-bot: Rotation status: completed (KMS rotation id kms-rot-20260319-8). Revocations: 43 tokens revoked.

oncall-eng: monitoring auth logs now for increased 401s as clients re-auth. We have a small bump but within acceptable restart behavior.

Sasha: received confirmation from external storage owner that ext-logs-prod-2026-03-19 has been quarantined and access restricted to sec+ops. They've started a purge job for objects flagged.

Marta: action items: 1) incident ticket with timeline (I got it). 2) legal review if any customer tokens were fully reconstructable (security to own). 3) cust-success to prepare templated notice if required.

cust-success: prepping draft notice but will hold until sec confirms no customer authentication tokens in plain text. ETA 3 hours.

Lena: safe rollback note: will revert fluent-forwarder filter config to include explicit header-exclude rule before re-enabling. Patch ready.

Omar: patch applied to exclude Authorization header fields and add stricter JSON key whitelist. Will re-enable forwarding in 30m after a validation run.

security-bot: Post-rotation checks: no active suspicious API calls tied to revoked tokens beyond initial few probes. Threat intel: likely misconfigured telemetry forwarder scraping headers, not targeted exfil.

Sasha: summarizing impact for runbook: forwarder misconfig allowed ephemeral auth header fragments to be sent to third-party bucket; ~40 token fragments found, 43 tokens revoked, no bodies/PII observed. Customer-visible impact: transient auth refresh failures for some clients.

Marta: closing loop: will request retention purge confirmation and keep incident open until purge complete and legal signs off. tagging sec/legal for formal review. :white_check_mark:
